newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH JULY JOBLESS RATE 9.4 PCT - LABOUR BOARD.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH JULY JOBLESS RATE 9.4 PCT - LABOUR BOARD.

text.p: Swedish unemployment rose to 10.8 percent in July from 9.4 percent in June, the National Labour Board said on Monday.
The board said 486,000 Swedes were unemployed in July, slightly lower than the 510,300 in July 1996 when unemployment was 11.3 percent.
The number of available positions rose by 2,300 to 16,800, the board said, adding the rise was mostly because of more jobs within education and health care.
According to official figures from Statistics Sweden, Swedish unemployment was 8.8 percent in June. Statistics Sweden is due to publish the official figure for July on August 15 at 1100 GMT.
